description: Build the invitation for one chosen slot. duration_minutes is the meeting length, chosen now, with the same choices as the planner Duration control. title is an optional meeting name, e.g. Weekly sync. Each city says whether that date is a public holiday. The first item is always the planner link: open this meeting on timeofmeeting.com (see and adjust it in the planner). formats then adds text to paste into a chat or email, a calendar file for Outlook, Apple Calendar and most calendar apps, an add-to-Google-Calendar link, or a QR code image someone can scan with a phone, in that order. The calendar file is https://timeofmeeting.com/c?q=. Use this after find_best_meeting_time, or when the time is already known.

cities.description: Two to eight cities. An array, or one comma-separated string. City name or a city id from search_cities. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

duration_minutes.description: Meeting length in minutes, chosen when the invitation is made. Same choices as the planner Duration control: 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, or any whole number from 5 to 1440 in steps of 5. Default 30.

formats.description: Extras after the planner link, which is always included: open this meeting on timeofmeeting.com (see and adjust it in the planner). Returned in this order: text (text to paste into a chat or email), ics (calendar file for Outlook, Apple Calendar and most calendar apps), google (add-to-Google-Calendar link), qr (QR code image someone can scan with a phone). Default when omitted: ["text", "ics", "google"]. An empty array returns the planner link only. qr is included only when requested.

oneOf.description: text to paste into a chat or email
calendar file for Outlook, Apple Calendar and most calendar apps
QR code image someone can scan with a phone

start.description: ISO time with Z or an offset, or a local time in the first city (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).

title.description: Optional meeting name, e.g. Weekly sync. It is the calendar event name and the first line of the text. When omitted, the invitation stays as it is now.

name: create_meeting_link

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

title: Create a meeting link
